description: Phase-21 RESEARCH-ONLY sampler-recall OVERLAY for bridge / router / cross-chain callback entrypoints. NOT the production sampler config: read ONLY by scripts/bridge_recall_sample.py (un-wired). Closes the Phase-20 Decent gap where score-5 callback entrypoints (UTB.receiveFromBridge, StargateBridgeAdapter.sgReceive) were never queued because no semantic_surface_patterns.json name_regex carried bridge-callback vocabulary. Inclusion requires TWO independent signals (name + trust-boundary/context); single-signal matches are refused. Generic verbs (handle/execute/dispatch/finalize/redeem/process/bridge/send) need STRONG context. The category generalizes by bridge-callback STRUCTURE, not just the example names.

_notes.name_signal: strong = callback_names_strong (explicit cross-chain callback); generic = callback_names_generic (counts ONLY with strong context); structural = no name match but contract is a receiver/adapter/gateway AND a payload/srcchain param is present.
_notes.context_signal: any of: payload/message/src-chain param (param_context_regex); a protocol_term or bridge primary term in contract/signature/body; the contract name matching interface_name_regex or an override of a known receiver. visibility MUST be external|public.
_notes.inclusion: include iff visibility in entrypoint_visibility AND name_signal(strong|structural) AND context_signal>=1. generic name => require STRONG context (param signal AND (protocol/interface signal)). single signal => REFUSED.
_notes.reuse: scripts/bridge_terms.PRIMARY_BRIDGE_TERMS supplies additional FP-tuned cross-chain context terms.
